summary: One module (mod set) being loaded by the client, driven step by step by ecl::ModuleLoadSystem (per-frame update bg3.exe+0x18B61B0); the first 0x18 bytes are an ls::ModuleSettings handed to the mod manager.

fields.name: ModuleUUIDString
fields.evidence: SE ModuleShortDesc layout; element stride 0x78 confirmed by the component destructor bg3.exe+0x6B8230 (eh_vector_destructor_iterator size 0x78, element dtor bg3.exe+0x5BCEF0).

fields.name: VMT
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x184A520 writes &PTR_FUN_1454c2bb0 at +0: the ls::ModuleSettings virtual table (SE ModuleSettings: VMT + Array<ModuleShortDesc> Mods). The update passes the component start to the mod manager (Windows FUN_143BC7870(modManager, comp); macOS ls::ModManager::LoadMod(mgr, (ModuleSettings*)comp)).

fields.name: Mods
fields.evidence: Creator zeroes +8 (pointer) and +0x10 (capacity/size); destructor bg3.exe+0x6B8230 destroys a new[]-allocated array at +8 with 0x78-byte elements. SE ModuleSettings.Mods.

fields.name: Progress
fields.evidence: Creator zeroes (4 bytes). bg3.exe+0x18B61B0 stores a float from a per-state table (0, 5, ..., 90, 100) here on each state change - loading progress in percent.

fields.name: LoadLocalization
fields.evidence: Creator writes 0 as a byte at +0x1C; bg3.exe+0x18B61B0 state 0 reads the byte and passes it to the localization load job (macOS: ecl::ModuleLoadSystem::DoLoadLoca(bool)).

fields.name: State
fields.evidence: Creator zeroes (4 bytes at +0x20); bg3.exe+0x18B61B0 switches on it (case 0, 1, 2, 3, ...) and writes the next state.
